apply_group_offloading: apply group offloading to a diffusers transformer model to reduce GPU memory usage by offloading layers to CPU
create_ModuleGroup: create a ModuleGroup that manages offloading and onloading of a group of PyTorch modules between CPU and GPU
create_GroupOffloadingHook: create a GroupOffloadingHook that attaches to modules to automatically offload parameters after forward and onload before forward
create_LazyPrefetchGroupOffloadingHook: create a LazyPrefetchGroupOffloadingHook that traces layer execution order during the first forward pass to enable async prefetching
create_GroupOffloadingConfig: create a GroupOffloadingConfig dataclass that specifies offloading behavior including devices, stream settings, and disk offload path
